scene.location: Culvert maintenance chamber beyond the first bend, north drainage gully outside Vespergate
scene.situation: Session 1 Turn 11. DevilMedlar disarmed and thoroughly searched the unconscious captured carver while Nyxara used DevilMedlar's 50-ft hempen rope to bind the captive's wrists, ankles, and torso securely. Investigation 19 - 1 = 18 against DC 14 succeeded. The captive carried a stone-carving chisel, a narrow boot knife, six compact-crossbow bolts, a small pouch containing 8 gp and 6 sp, a small brass key with a three-coil notch pattern, and the dark cross-body satchel. His dropped compact crossbow was secured away from him. DevilMedlar then swept the maintenance chamber for accomplices, exits, threats, and useful items. Perception 17 + 3 = 20 against DC 13 succeeded. No accomplice is currently present and no second fresh set of tracks was found beyond Nyxara's known trail; the captive appears to have occupied the chamber alone. Two routes leave the chamber besides the way back: a narrow drainage passage continues east/deeper into the culvert, and a rusted vertical service shaft climbs to a grated surface exit above the gully. The surface grate appears usable but noisy. A hooded lantern and one flask of lamp oil were also recovered near the captive's firing position. DevilMedlar then opened the leather-bound book. The Investigation success and Nyxara's recognition confirmed it is the stolen Velvet Coil ledger. It contains names, dates, payments, movement routes, and coded marks identifying watched or selected people. A repeated route notation references 'Vespergate / Silken Cup / cellar delivery', establishing a new Vespergate lead. Nyxara found the entry tied to the woman she loves and confirmed the ledger is genuine, saying it is what she was after but worse than she expected. She still withheld the woman's name and exact relationship. DevilMedlar flirted lightly while asking whether the ledger matched what Nyxara expected; she answered with dry amusement and remained focused. The captive remains unconscious, stable, bound, and alive. No combat or resource-limited ability use occurred.

clues.captured_carver: Unconscious, stable, securely bound with DevilMedlar's rope, fully disarmed, and still unidentified by name/allegiance/motive.
clues.ledger_confirmed: The leather-bound book is confirmed as the stolen Velvet Coil ledger. It records names, dates, payments, routes, and coded marks tied to watched/selected people.
clues.nyxara_ledger_entry: Nyxara confirmed the entry concerning the woman she loves is present. The woman's name and exact relationship remain undisclosed.
clues.silken_cup_lead: A repeated ledger route notation reads 'Vespergate / Silken Cup / cellar delivery'. Exact significance remains unresolved.
clues.chamber_routes: Beyond the return route, an eastward deeper drainage passage and a noisy rusted vertical service shaft to a surface grate leave the maintenance chamber.
clues.accomplice_sweep: Perception 20 found no current accomplice and no additional fresh track set in or beyond the chamber.
clues.carver_key: Small brass key with a three-coil notch pattern recovered from the captive; matching lock unknown.
